coordinate_format: rect = [x, y, width, height], origin at upper left, in decoded source pixels
coordinate_method: Manually measured enclosing edit regions against the full-resolution decoded images. Rectangles include small deliberate padding; they are not claimed to be OCR glyph contours.
status: translation and region draft; image pixels have not been changed
rendering_notes: Preserve original button icons, controller diagram, connecting lines, decorative borders, English copyright/trademark notices and background art.
Suggested font sizes are starting points, not fit verification. Reflow paragraphs only within verified free space and inspect every rendered page at native size.
Rectangles around mixed icon/text sentences require retaining or redrawing the exact original button icon; button_labels records its meaning.
Dimmed screenshot text is baked into these textures. Executable string replacement alone cannot translate it. Some background labels are occluded and need separate layer-aware handling.
Contact details are a faithful translation of historical game artwork, not a claim of current support availability.

regions.reading_description: Four-line opening software and console safety notice
regions.en:
Before using this software, carefully read the precautions in its accompanying documentation and in the PlayStation®3 instruction manual, and use it correctly.
Parents or guardians should read these precautions for young children and ensure that they use the software safely.

regions.reading_description: Warning text beside the existing warning triangle
Heading about seizures caused by light stimulation
Photosensitive seizure symptoms and consultation before play
regions.en: Flashing screens and other visual stimuli may, in rare cases, cause eye pain, visual disturbances, migraines, convulsions, or impaired consciousness, including fainting (photosensitive seizures). If you have experienced these symptoms, consult a doctor before playing.

regions.reading_description: Caution text beside the existing warning triangle
Stop playing immediately under these circumstances
regions.en: Stop Playing Immediately If You Feel Unwell

regions.reading_description: Additional symptoms, discomfort in specified body areas, stopping and medical consultation
regions.en: In addition to the symptoms above, stop playing immediately if you experience headache, dizziness, nausea, fatigue, motion sickness, or discomfort or pain in your eyes, ears, hands, arms, feet, or any other part of your body. If symptoms persist after stopping, consult a doctor.

regions.reading_description: Heading for software supporting controller vibration
People with vibration-related disorders must not use vibration
regions.en: If you have a vibration-related medical condition, do not use the vibration function.

regions.reading_description: Vibration can be toggled through the menu opened with the PS button
regions.en: You can turn vibration on or off in the menu displayed by pressing the controller's PS button.

regions.reading_description: First square bullet: bright room and distance from display
regions.en: Play in a well-lit room and sit as far from the screen as possible.

regions.reading_description: Second square bullet: avoid play while tired or sleep-deprived
regions.en: Avoid playing when tired or short of sleep.

regions.reading_description: Third square bullet: about fifteen minutes per hour
regions.en: For your health, take a break of about 15 minutes every hour.

regions.reading_description: Fourth square bullet: stop at once when unwell during play
regions.en: Stop playing immediately if you begin to feel unwell.
This software is for use only with PlayStation®3.

regions.reading_description: Second bullet: plasma and non-LCD projection televisions, burn-in and static images
regions.en: Connecting PlayStation®3 to a plasma television or a non-LCD projection television may cause image burn-in (a lingering image). Burn-in is particularly likely if a still image is left on the screen for a long time.

regions.reading_description: Third bullet: keep console system software updated
regions.en: Always update your PlayStation®3 system software to the latest version.
